main_failure_modes: The root-cause finding used anchoring bias instead of Fundamental Attribution Bias and did not fully capture the person-versus-situation attribution mechanism.
The alignment finding used overconfidence bias instead of the hidden Illusion of Control label, producing a strict taxonomy error despite a full mechanism match.
The two near-neighbor labels reduce strict precision and recall to 0.5000 despite perfect segment-level detection.
main_strengths: All four biased reasoning segments were found and correctly localized.
Gambler's Fallacy and Ambiguity Effect were identified with exact label, mechanism, and evidence matches.
The alignment finding fully captured the hidden control-overestimation mechanism under the mechanism-first scorecard.

Mechanism-first scoring raises F1 from 0.5000 to 0.7500, showing a measurable taxonomy gap rather than a broad failure to detect the biased reasoning.
